# Mandate

> Spend-control proxy for agencies running AI agents. Keep real OpenAI/Anthropic keys encrypted server-side; issue capped `mdt_live_…` keys; point n8n (or any OpenAI-compatible client) at Mandate base URLs.

Base URL (production): https://trymandate.dev
OpenAI proxy: https://trymandate.dev/openai/v1
Anthropic proxy: https://trymandate.dev/anthropic/v1

## Docs

- [Human docs](https://trymandate.dev/docs): Quickstart, n8n, errors, free credits
- [Quickstart (LLM)](https://trymandate.dev/docs/quickstart.md)
- [n8n setup (LLM)](https://trymandate.dev/docs/n8n.md)
- [API & auth (LLM)](https://trymandate.dev/docs/api.md)
- [Errors (LLM)](https://trymandate.dev/docs/errors.md)
